financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of 617,345 shares under 2025 ATM Program, July 1 through Aug 11, 2026
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Subsequent to June 30, 2026 and through August 11, 2026, the Company has sold and issued 617,345 additional shares of common stock under the 2025 ATM Program, for total net proceeds of $6.3 million.

warrants.quote: the Company issued to the purchaser of the Series B Preferred warrants to purchase 3,672,484 shares of common stock for $6.81
the Company issued to the same stockholder additional five-year warrants for the purchase of 3,672,484 shares of common stock for $6.81 per share (the Conditional Series B Warrants)
The warrant provides the beneficiary the right to purchase 162,740 shares of the Company’s common stock, $0.01 par value at an exercise price of $1.46 per share
As of June 30, 2026, there were 254,642 Lender Warrants outstanding.
